data.body: DD8 (prerequisite — fixes bug 4ba5): correct the net-end-state diff computation in build-integration-diff.sh / llm-review-dispatch-or-skip.sh for MERGE COMMITS. Today a conflict-resolution merge commit whose real delta is the version field computes 0 touched files, so the 'empty net diff on unprovenanced range -> fail-closed' contract hard-blocks the PR (4ba5). This is LOAD-BEARING for DD2/DD3a: the version-file exemption checks 'diff entirely within version.file_path', and the I-1 'empty file list = NOT exempt' guard would be FALSELY tripped by the same mis-computation -> the exemption cannot fire until the merge-commit net-diff is correct. Fix: net-end-state diff for a merge commit must report the files its conflict resolution actually changed vs main (the version line), so (a) a version-only resolution is correctly exempt, and (b) a genuinely-empty diff is distinguishable from a mis-computed-empty one. Reuse the design's rebase-not-merge path to AVOID version merge commits where possible, but the diff computation must still be correct for any other unprovenanced merge commit. Add a regression test reproducing 4ba5 (merge commit resolving a version conflict -> non-empty net diff = version file only -> exempt, not blocked).
